name: Resolve AI
description:
Resolve AI provides agents to run and fix your production software: on-call agents that triage your on-call alerts, incident agents that investigate incidents to determine root cause with high accuracy, and background agents that run continuous operational work. 
This Connector brings all three with live production context into your Claude ecosystem. You can pull that context on demand, ask follow-up questions, steer an active investigation with local context, and take a root cause and remediation plan through to a pull request, without leaving Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Resolve AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Resolve AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app0.resolve.ai/mcp/v2. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Resolve AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Resolve AI provides these MCP tools: ask, get_chat, get_investigation, list_alerts, list_chats, list_investigations, read_file, start_investigation, steer_investigation, submit_feedback, and upload_attachment.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Resolve AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Resolve AI in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: Does Resolve AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Resolve AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Resolve AI is developed by Resolve AI, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
